First, the Lourdes Medical Bureau examines whether the illness was serious and whether the healing is real and lasting. Then the International Medical Committee of Lourdes judges whether the healing is unexplained according to set criteria. Finally, the one who publicly recognizes the healing as a miracle is the bishop of the healed person’s diocese, not the shrine or the doctors.
